notes.title: Mirror 2: Project X Official Trailer! With Surprises!
notes.content:
Many of you may have known this, but indulge us to introduce to you: Mirror 2: Project X Store Page has been revealed! 

We’ve prepared a special Trailer for all our supporter, there’s a surprise in it, please don’t miss it! [previewyoutube=3ZZxoaI_gTc;full][/previewyoutube]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A side project of the Mirror Series – Mirror Party is now released in Early Access! There’s a discount and two promotions, check it now! 

Promotion One: Mirror Party Early Access Release Event

Purchase Mirror Party before 11:59 PM, December 10, 2021 (UTC+8) and the playtime of Mirror Party exceeds 3 hours. Go to the website and click the big round button to participate. 

Prizes: 
        8 PlayStation 5
	50 Mirror Series Deluxe Merch Pack
	600 Mirror Series Merch Pack
	TONS of Steam Keys

Promotion Webs: https://activity.mirror-2.com/p/mirror_party_EA_release_event

Promotion Two: Mirror Thank-You Event

Purchase Mirror Party before 11:59 PM, December 10, 2021 (UTC+8) and the playtime of Mirror exceeds 3 hours. Go to the website and click the big round button to participate. 

Prizes: One PlayStation 5

Promotion Webs: https://activity.mirror-2.com/p/mirror_thank-you_event

※Please check the web page for more details about the events.
